desc:
A co-op card RPG for 1–5 players, inspired by Wizard101.

Choose your school. Build your deck. Every defeat teaches you something.

8 schools of magic. 150+ spells. 8 lands to cross and 11 bosses along the way, from Bramblehorn in the Forest to the Abyssal Warden at the bottom of the raid.

Raise a pet, ride a mount, trade with other players, or rest in the AFK World between fights.

Join our group to redeem codes and our server for a list of codes & patch notes!
